    def __new__(cls, name, constituents=None, charge=0):
        if constituents is not None:
            new_self = object.__new__(cls)
            new_self.name = name
            new_self.constituents = constituents
            new_self.charge = charge
            return new_self
        else:
            arg = name
        # if a Species is passed in, return it
        if arg.__class__ == cls:
            return arg
        new_self = object.__new__(cls)
        if arg == '*':
            new_self = object.__new__(cls)
            new_self.name = '*'
            new_self.constituents = dict()
            new_self.charge = 0
            return new_self
        if arg is None:
            new_self = object.__new__(cls)
            new_self.name = ''
            new_self.constituents = dict()
            new_self.charge = 0
            return new_self

        if isinstance(arg, str):
            parse_list = parse_chemical_formula(arg.upper())
        else:
            parse_list = arg
        new_self.name = name
        new_self.charge = parse_list[1]
        parse_list = parse_list[0]
        new_self.constituents = dict(parse_list)
        return new_self

    def __getnewargs__(self):
        return self.name, self.constituents, self.charge

    def __eq__(self, other):
        """Two species are the same if their names and constituents are the same."""
        if isinstance(other, self.__class__):
            return (self.name == other.name) and (self.constituents == other.constituents)
        else:
            return False

    def __ne__(self, other):
        return not self.__eq__(other)

    def __lt__(self, other):
        return self.name < other.name

    def __str__(self):
        return self.name

    @property
    def escaped_name(self):
        "Name safe to embed in the variable name of complex arithmetic expressions."
        return str(self).replace('-', '_NEG').replace('+', '_POS').replace('/', 'Z')

    @property
    def number_of_atoms(self):
        "Number of atoms per formula unit. Vacancies do not count as atoms."
        return sum(value for key, value in self.constituents.items() if key != 'VA')

    @property
    def weight(self):
        "Number of grams per formula unit."
        return NotImplementedError

    def __repr__(self):
        if self.name == '*':
            return '*'
        if self.name == '':
            return 'None'
        species_constituents = ''.join(
            ['{}{}'.format(el, val) for el, val in sorted(self.constituents.items(), key=lambda t: t[0])])
        if self.charge == 0:
            repr_str = "(\'{0}\', \'{1}\')"
        else:
            repr_str = "(\'{0}\', \'{1}\', charge={2})"
        return str(self.__class__.__name__)+repr_str.format(self.name.upper(), species_constituents, self.charge)

75:A Model is an abstract representation of the molar Gibbs energy function of a phase. def _partitioned_sublattices(self, disordered_model):
        """Match each parent sublattice to its ordered position classes.

        A partition conserves the relative number of sites in each parent
        sublattice, allowing a common rescaling of the formula unit. Constituents
        identify the position classes, not individual species shared by distinct
        sublattices. Use the full declarations when possible, then the active
        constituents for descriptions that coincide only in a subsystem.
        """
        ordered_phase = self._dbe.phases[self.phase_name]
        disordered_phase = self._dbe.phases[disordered_model.phase_name]
        ordered_ratios = np.asarray(ordered_phase.sublattices, dtype=float)
        disordered_ratios = np.asarray(disordered_phase.sublattices, dtype=float)
        ordered_ratios = ordered_ratios / ordered_ratios.sum()
        disordered_ratios = disordered_ratios / disordered_ratios.sum()
        ordered_indices = tuple(range(len(self.constituents)))

        def partitions(parent_constituents, ordered_constituents, parent_idx=0,
                       remaining=ordered_indices):
            if parent_idx == len(parent_constituents):
                if not remaining:
                    yield ()
                return
            candidates = [idx for idx in remaining
                          if ordered_constituents[idx] == parent_constituents[parent_idx]]
            # Leave at least one position for each remaining parent sublattice.
            max_size = min(len(candidates), len(remaining) - len(parent_constituents) + parent_idx + 1)
            for size in range(1, max_size + 1):
                for group in combinations(candidates, size):
                    if not np.isclose(sum(ordered_ratios[idx] for idx in group),
                                      disordered_ratios[parent_idx], rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-12):
                        continue
                    rest = tuple(idx for idx in remaining if idx not in group)
                    for tail in partitions(parent_constituents, ordered_constituents,
                                           parent_idx + 1, rest):
                        yield (group,) + tail

        for parent_constituents, ordered_constituents in (
                (disordered_phase.constituents, ordered_phase.constituents),
                (disordered_model.constituents, self.constituents)):
            matches = []

                # Repeated identical sublattices follow their declared order.
                # Otherwise constituent sets and site ratios must identify a
                # unique mapping, including when spectators are permuted.
